_about: How-to details for the annual remedies shown on the Rituals card. Edit the wording here; the match is a case-insensitive regex on the remedy sentence. Keep it plain: no planet, book or method names. {day} is the weekday named in the remedy; {covers} is what that weekday stands for.

remedies.how_plain: Eat lightly: skip your usual meals and keep to water, milk or fruit until evening, then break it with a simple meal.
remedies.safety_plain: Skip the fast, or keep it very light, if you are unwell, pregnant, diabetic or on medication.

remedies.how_plain: Say it 11 times, slowly and out loud or under your breath, ideally at sunrise or before you start work.
remedies.for_plain: Steadies the mind and sharpens focus.

remedies.how_plain: Give a cow green fodder or a roti with jaggery, or contribute to a cow shelter.
remedies.when_plain: Any day; doing it regularly matters more than the day
remedies.for_plain: Eases the strain your year carries.
